question: Which of the following is NOT a correct match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Capacitance - Dyne.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Capacitance **is measured in **Farads**, not Dyne.
 
• **Dyne **is a unit of **force**.
 
• **Voltage **is measured in **Volts**,
 
 
• which quantifies the electrical **potential difference**;
 
 
 
• **Resistance**, quantifying how much a material **opposes the flow of electric current,**
 
 
• It is measured in **Ohms.**
 
 
 
• **Conductance**,** the inverse of resistance**, indicating how easily electricity flows through a material,
 
 
• It is measured in **Siemens**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **International System of Units (SI) **is a standardized system of measurement used worldwide. Here are the seven base SI units:

 
 
• **Meter (m):** The unit of length, 
 
• **Kilogram (kg):** The unit of mass,
 
• **Ampere (A): **The unit of electric current, 
 
• **Second (s) :** The unit of time
 
• **Kelvin (K): **The unit of thermodynamic temperature, 
 
• **Mole (mol)**: The unit of amount of substance, 
 
• **Candela (cd):** The unit of luminous intensity, 
 
 
 
• In addition to these base units, there are **derived SI units**, which are formed by combining the base units according to the rules of algebraic equations. Examples of **derived units** include **the Pascal (Pa) for pressure**, and **the Joule (J) for energy.**
